canonical_name: Bounded gaps between consecutive primes below seventy million (published consequence; exact Lean encoding open)
literal_source_claim_zh: 存在无穷多对素数差小于7000万
literal_source_claim_en: There are infinitely many pairs of primes whose difference is less than seventy million.
source_attribution: Yitang Zhang, 2013 (catalog metadata; primary paper published in 2014)
